tei:div.tei:p: ('a)༄༅// sngags lam gyi rten ngos 'dzin pa dang sbyang gzhi phra rags rnam par bshad pa bzhugs so// swasti/ khyab bdag 'khor los bsgyur ba la// phyag 'tshal nas ni gsang sngags kyi// lam gyi rten gang yin pa dang*// sbyang gzhi phra rags rnam gsum bshad// gsang sngags bla na med pa yi// lam gyi dngos rten sems can khams// gong ma gnyis la ma bshad phyir// 'dod pa'i khams pa kho na las// rgod dang bltas dang lag bcangs kyi// bde bas tshim pa'i lha dag ni// bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum po'i// lam gyi rten du mtshungs par bshad// khams drug can gyi mi dag ni// kho na bla med theg pa yis// rdo rje sems dpa' tshe gcig la// bsgrub pa'i lam rten mtshungs par bshad// dmyal ba pa dag ma gtogs pa// 'dod pa'i 'gro ba rigs lnga po// mtha' dag dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang*// dur khrod brgyad kyi lhag bkod pa// mang phyir de dag ci rigs nas// gsang sngags lam gyi rten du rung*// khyad par skyed rim bsgrub pa'i rten// mi yi 'gro ba pa dag dang*// rdzogs rim rten ni khams drug po// 'dus pa'i mi lus khyad par can// yin gyi za ma ma ning dang*// mdze can smyo 'bog la sogs pa// nad kyi gzir dang byang gi ni// sgra mi snyan pa rnams kyang min// rten gyi gang zag ces bya ba// kun rdzob don dam dbye bas gnyis// dang po lhan skyes ma rig pa'i// zag bcas phung po lnga dag la// yong ma myong ba'i gang zag zhig /'khrul nas btags pa gang de'o// 'di nyid las 'bras rten yin phyir// gsang sngags lam gyi sgrub po'ang de// 'khor dang rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'ang de// yin zhes phyi rabs pa rnams 'dod// 'di 'dra mu stegs kyis btags pa'i// bdag de 'khor ba po dang ni// grol ba por yang 'dod pa dang*// mtshungs phyir mkhas pas spang bar bya// de phyir don dam skyes bu ni// skyed rim rten du 'dir bshad pa// dang po stong pa nyid bsam nas// ye shes rdo rje nga yin zhes// nga med pa la ngar btags pa'i// don dam nga de gsal btab nas// de nyid 'khor lo bde mchog tu// lam gyi dus su gsal btab nas// 'bras bu'i dus su'ang de kho na// rdzogs sangs rgyas bar bzhed pa yin// 'o na sems can thams cad kyi// gnyis med ye shes rdo rje de// don dam pa yi gang zag tu// bye brag med pa ma yin nam// sems can thams cad bla med kyi// skyed rim rten du thal zhe na// lus sems khyad par can med pa// rdzogs rim rten du mi 'thad phyir// rdzogs rim rten du mi ldan pa'i// gang zag skyed rim rten du min// mu stegs byed kyis btags pa'i bdag

/tha snyad du yang yod min mod// lhan skyes ma rig gis btags bdag /'jig rten don dam bden zhe na// de yi don dam theg chen por// zhugs tshe kun rdzob bden yin phyir// yod ma yin no gang med pa// lam gyi rten du 'chad mi nus// 'o na khams drug ldan pa'i lus// rdzogs rim rten la'ang mtshungs she na// kun rdzob rten cing 'brel 'byung gi /lus la rten 'brel 'grig tsam gyis// sems la rtogs pa 'char nus pa// nyid phyir de la der btags so// zhib mor phye na rdzogs rim gyi// rten yang don dam lus nyid de// mkha' gsang mi dmigs par byas nas// bde chen mngon du byed phyir ro// rim pa gnyis po'i rten du ni// kun rdzob yod med mtshungs she na// mtshungs min skyed rim rten de nyid// skyed rim nyid du sgrub byed kyi// rdzogs rim rten ni rdzogs rim gyi// ye shes nyid du sgrub mi byed// skyed rim rten gyi nga nyid ni// skyed pa'i rim pa'i nyer len rgyu// rdzogs rim rten ni bde chen gyi// lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen du bshad// khams drug ldan pa'i lus kho na// 'dir bstan dgos pa'i shes byed ni// so so skye bos tshe gcig la// rdzogs sangs rgya ba nye rgyu yis// mtshams sbyor ba la rag las phyir// de med pa la de mi 'byung*// nye rgyu las byung ye shes ni// bde stong zung du 'jug pa ste// mthong lam nas tsam rgyun mtha'i bar// skad cig cig gis rdzogs sangs rgya// skyed pa'i rim pas ma sbyangs par// nye rgyus mtshams sbyor 'khor ba'i lam// sbyangs pas drod gsum gang rung ste// thob nas spyod pa gsum spyod pa// bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs pa dang*// bdag tu rmongs pa sel byed pa'o// rim gnyis ye shes go rim bzhin// tshogs gnyis po dang sgrib pa gnyis// rdzogs dang spong ba'i gnyen por ni// bshad phyir gnyis po'i lag rjes kyang*// rang snang chos kyi sku dang ni// gzhan snang gzugs kyi sku bshad bya// de nas sbyang gzhi sbyong sbyangs dang*// spang bya spong spangs shes bya ba'i// khyad par dbye bas gnas gyur dang*// gnas mi 'dod pa'i tshul bshad bya// sbyang gzhi zhes bya gnas yin te// ngos 'dzin phra rag bar ma gsum// phra ba dri bcas chos dbyings te// rags pa ma dag phung sogs dang*// bar ma kun gzhi'i rnam shes so// gang du sbyong ba'i gnas dang ni// gang zhig sbyong ba'i dri ma dag

/mnyam du tshogs pa'i 'bral rung la// sbyang gzhi zhes byar tha snyad btags// gzhi ni spang byar mi 'jog ste// de der bzhag na gnas gyur pa// zhes bya'i rnam gzhag mi 'thad dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas tshe ye shes kyang*// chad pa nyid du thal ba dang*// mya ngan 'das tshe bdag chad pa'i// som nyi don dang ldan par 'gyur// rang rang ngo bos mi stong pa'i// chos dbyings yod par mi bzhed na// gnas gyur pa dang lhag med tshe// ye shes khas len nus ma yin// sbyang gzhi sbyong dang gnas gyur gyi// rnam gzhag chos 'khor gsum pa yi// mdo dang gsang sngags gnyis ka'i lugs// bskyed pa'i rim pas ma dag pa'i// snod bcud sdug bsngal bden pa dang*// de rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa// mnyam du spong phyir phar phyin pa'i// 'khor ba spong tshul las 'di 'phags// dbang bskur ba yi byin brlabs kyis// gnyis med rang rig rang gsal ba// mngon du gyur pa'i sgrub pa pos// ye shes de nyid las bsgrub pa'i// 'byung ba rim brtsegs nas bzung ste// snod bcud ma lus gsal thebs nas// gsal ba rab kyi mthar phyin pa// de goms byed po'i rnam 'byor pas// rang rang las kyi rnam smin dang*// bdag po'i 'bras bu kun sbyangs nas// de dang de yi gzung 'dzin gyi// rtog pa'i dri ma dang bral tshe// rang rang sdug bsngal kun 'byung sogs// bskyed pa'i rim pas sbyangs shes bya// de yang gnyis med ye shes ni// bdag dang chos su rmongs pa yi// 'gal ba mi mthun phyogs goms pa'i// ngang las g.yo ba med bzhin du// rten dang brten par bcas goms pa// rang rang sdug bsngal bden pa yi// 'gal ba mi mthun phyogs goms pa'o// rim pa dang po'i lta ba yis// kun 'byung sa bon spong nus mod// rnam smin sdug bsngal bag chags la// gnod par byed kyang dngos su ni// zad par byed pa rdzogs rim gyi// ye shes las gzhan yod ma yin// rdzogs rim bde stong zung 'jug blos// rnam smin sdug bsngal phung po dang*// sgrib kun sa bon sel nus mod// nyon mongs bag chags ched du ni// mi spong phyir na shes sgrib kyi// gnyen po nyid du gtso cher bzhag

/rim pa dang po'i spang bya yi// nyon mongs 'khor bar 'ching byed nyid// yin phyir de yis de sbyong ba'i// rnam gzhag rgyas par bshad nyid do// nyon mongs de yi lus ngag yid// yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa// lnga tshan gcig tu grangs nges phyir/ skyed rim skabs su de sbyong ba'i// gnyen po lha lnga las mi nyung*// zhes pa las dang po la ste// brten par gyur nas nyon mongs pa// kun kyang ma rig par 'dus bzhin// rigs lnga po yang kun bsdus na// rdo rje sems dpar ma 'dus med// sbyang gzhi rnam gzhag rim pa las// bskal pa dang po'i 'jig rten khams// bcud dang bcas te stong pa dang*// rim gyis 'grub dang gnas pa'i tshul// rgyas par bshad nas de sbyong ba'i// skyed rim rnam gzhag gsungs pa la// phyis byon gzhan dag cha mthun gyi// bsgom tshul yin gyi spang bya yi// gnyen po ma yin zhig zin pa'i// spong gnyen chos kyi grags pas bkag /zhes zer ba na de nyid kyi// grub mtha' 'jog nyes pa las byung*// ci phyir zhe na thogs med kyi// 'khor ba'i bag chags ma lus pa// rang rang kun gzhi'i rnam shes la// bzhag pa sbyang bar ma byas na// ma 'ong dus su snod dang ni// bcud kyi ngo bor smin 'gyur phyir// skye 'gyur sdug bsngal phung po yi// sa bon bag chags da lta ba// gnyen pos phrad nas 'joms pa ni// shing rta'i srol chen dag las 'byung*// zhig pa'i gnyen por mi 'dod ni// chos mthun bsgom nas ci zhig bya// sbyang gzhi sbyong bar khas blangs nas// gnas 'gyur mi 'dod pa yang 'gal// rang rang dri bcas chos kyi dbyings// yongs rdzogs bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*// dbyer med nyid du 'dres pa'i tshe// ma dag skyed rim dbyings su yal// 'o na kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas tshe gnas 'dod dam// zhe na de yi gsal cha'am// zag pa med pa'i sems rgyud tsam// gnas nas dri ma gzhan gyur tshe// gnas 'gyur pa zhes tha snyad btags// gzugs can phung sogs mi 'dor tshe// sbyang gzhi ji ltar gnas she na// gzugs can phung khams skye mched du// snang ba'i rnam rig las gzhan pa'i// gzugs sogs yod par mi 'dod mod// rnam rig de ni gzhan dbang dang*// yongs su grub pa'i tshogs don te// yongs grub gnas shing dri ma'i cha// gzhan gyur tshe na gnas gyur pa'o// mdor na sbyang gzhi gsal rig nyid// yin phyir spang byar de mi 'dod// gzhan dbang dri ma'i cha spangs pa// de tshe gnas gyur zhes bya'o// rdzogs pa'i rim pas mi spong ba'i// spang bya yod pa ma yin zhing*// bde ba chen pos mi rdzogs pa'i// yon tan yod pa ma yin na// skyed rim dgos pa ci zhe na// lhar bskyed pa dang sngags bzla dang*// sbyin bsreg gtor ma'i cho ga sogs// bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs pa dang*// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pas// sgrib kun sel dang yon tan kun// lhur len byed pa go rim bzhin// ma tshangs med pa spel ba las// sgrib kun spangs dang yon tan kun// rdzogs pa'i chos kyi sku dang ni// lhun grub rgyun mi chad pa yi// gzhan snang gzugs sku nyi ma bzhin// zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o//

//shu bhaṃ// //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
